author: Josh Hodell
title: Showers, thunderstorms expected Wednesday night - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Hodell Julia Priest ,
7 hours ago
(WBRE/WYOU) — Authorities said parts of Pennsylvania were under a Severe Thunderstorm Warning and a Flash Flood Warning for Wednesday night.
The National Weather Service (NWS) announced shortly before 5:45 p.m. a Flash Flood Warning for East Central Bradford County until 8:45 p.m. after a storm was detected by radar and automated rain gauges showed thunderstorms passing through the Keystone State bring heavy rain. The warning has since expired.
Authorities say one and a half to two inches of rain have already fallen in the areas anticipated to be impacted.
The NWS warns residents to take proper precautions when encountering an area experiencing flash flooding by turning around and to not drown.
Later, just after 8:00 p.m., the NWS announced the following counties were under a Severe Thunderstorm Warning until 9:00 p.m. which has since expired.
Susquehanna County Lackawanna County Wayne County Pike County Wyoming County Officials say a severe thunderstorm was spotted near the area of Factoryville moving east at 35 miles per hour. Authorities warn winds can reach up to 60 miles per hour with hail as large as a quarter. Hail damage is expected along with wind damage to siding, trees, and roofs in the anticipated impacted areas.
If you are in the areas anticipated to be impacted by the severe thunderstorms, the NWS says to move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a building.
Regional Weather Forecasts We’re tracking a few showers and thunderstorms Wednesday night. If you get a stronger storm at your home, the main threats will be downpours and gusty winds. It will be a warm and muggy night with low temperatures in the 60s. Patchy fog will develop towards morning.
Thursday will be warm and a bit humid. Afternoon temperatures will reach the lower and middle 80s. Some of the higher elevations could end up staying in the upper 70s. A shower or storm is possible in the afternoon. However, most of the time will be dry.
It’s almost a repeat forecast on Friday. Almost. You can expect a mix of clouds and sun through the day. In addition, there is a small chance of a shower or thunderstorm. The bigger difference will be in the humidity. Through the afternoon and evening, it will ease up and feel more comfortable than the last several days.
Better sleeping weather is on the way for Friday night and Saturday morning. Temperatures will be in the 50s! Plenty of sun on Saturday along with low humidity will let temperatures climb to near 80°. Enjoy, because we don’t expect it to last. Sunday will be more humid with the chance of a shower or thunderstorm. The speed of this storm system is fairly uncertain, as you would expect this far in advance. The rain has the potential to start in the morning or it could hold off until afternoon. We’ll update you as we get closer.
A shower or thunderstorm will linger into Monday. Then, we should dry out on Tuesday and Wednesday. High temperatures will be near 80°, if not in the lower 80s.
